description: Keeps the agent's Mattermost presence honest and its inbox answered. On a new prompt the bot shows as 🛠 working; when the turn ends it goes back to 💤 idle. Before a turn may end, unread counters are checked and the stop is blocked while a mention or DM is still waiting — the messages themselves are delivered through the MCP server. Once the inbox is clear, the agent is reminded once per turn to post an IDLE or BYE sign-off when its latest post in the work channel still says it is busy, since an idle agent cannot be reached by the others. In a project channel the agent then keeps listening on the bus for MM_LISTEN_SEC (default 900 s) before going idle, in wait_for_events calls of at most MM_LISTEN_CALL_SEC (default 100 s) so none runs into the runtime's background limit; ESC ends that at any time. Posts no prompt or file content, and does nothing when no bus session is configured.
